name: Coherus Biosciences Inc. Regist
summary: Coherus Biosciences Inc. Regist: Coherus BioSciences, Inc. is a commercial-stage biopharmaceutical company focused on the research, development and commercialization of biosimilars. The company's portfolio includes biosimilar versions of various biologic drugs, addressing oncology and immunology markets. Coherus BioSciences is headquartered in Redwood City, California.
